The dish is a stainless steel mixing bowl, probably about 25-28 cm across at the rim. The food covers a patch roughly 12-15 cm wide in the center.

The food is shredded carrot with shaved Parmesan on top.
- **Carrot:** a thin layer of about 80-100 g, at roughly 41 kcal per 100 g, gives about 40 kcal.
- **Parmesan:** about 25-30 g of shavings, at roughly 430 kcal per 100 g, gives about 115 kcal.

Together that is about 120 g of food and about 155 kcal. I'm allowing a little extra for possible dressing, so I'll round up slightly.
